mobbin:cc3eb338-5efa-4102-9440-b4764ee90.summary: From Security and Drivers, the user opens Dashcam Viewer and browses saved clips filtered by All, Sentry or Dashcam, grouped by date with time and trigger type.
steal: Segmented All / Sentry / Dashcam filters separate recording trigger types before opening a clip (screen 2).
Date headers plus thumbnail, time and type label (for example Sentry) make a long clip library easy to scan (screen 2).
A single named entry 'Dashcam Viewer · View saved clips' keeps rewatch findable inside a dense settings list (screen 1).
avoid: The flow stops at the library, with no playback, markers or multi-camera chooser, so it is thin for SRV or debrief review itself.
mobbin:cc3eb338-5efa-4102-9440-b4764ee90.fit: Debrief and review: useful for a session or clip library before opening the SRV. It does not show camera-angle switching or in-player rewatch controls.
